generations.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the supplied whale-girl idle sprite reference into a smoother restrained idle animation, preserving the selected character's face, clothes and B body proportions.
Create exactly EIGHT unique chronological frames on a 2048x1024 TRANSPARENT canvas, FOUR columns and TWO rows, equal 512x512 cells. Each cell contains one full character at the same frontal angle and same scale and registration. Actual transparent alpha, no visible backdrop, shadows, gridlines, labels or text. Clean high-resolution anime line art for a 110px desktop character.
Identity lock: navy hair with blue ends, blue eyes, white scalloped headband, tiny curved ahoge, small whale-fin ears, navy dress, single plain white apron with blue whale emblem, one neck bow, white socks, navy shoes, whale tail curved out to the side. Keep headband-to-chin about 50-52% of full character height (the reference B proportion), don't make an oversized head, no extra lace or ornament. No redesign.
All soles planted together on y=475, body center x=256 in EVERY cell. Crown about y=45. Feet and pelvis stay precisely fixed. Upper body breath motion at most 3 px; small tail and hair-tip motion only, stable silhouette and face identity. Smooth loop with true intermediate drawings, no squash/stretch of the whole character.
Eight frames in row-major order: 1 relaxed neutral eyes fully open, tail neutral; 2 beginning inhale, tiny hair-tip/tail follow-through; 3 inhale peak, eyelids 30% lowered; 4 eyelids 65% lowered; 5 complete gentle blink eyes closed (not smiling), breath relaxed; 6 eyelids opening 60%; 7 eyelids 20% lowered; 8 fully open relaxed neutral, hair and tail easing back to first pose. Blink uses smooth intermediate eyelid shapes, no face angle, jaw or facial proportion changes. Keep sleepiness subtle, no giant swaying or bouncing. This is an idle loop not a dance.
Purpose: effective subtle intermediate poses and short blink timing, while normal open-eye rest will be held longer by the application. The first/last poses must connect smoothly but are not duplicated.

Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: transparent 2D desktop character animation sprite sheet.
Input image 1 is the selected whale-girl idle reference and identity authority. Input image 2 is the previous walking draft; keep its right-facing three-quarter camera but REPLACE the gait, which repeats the same leading leg.
Create a new high-quality 12-frame walking cycle, exactly FOUR columns by THREE rows on a 1536x1536 transparent canvas (384x512 cells). Row-major chronological sequence. Each cell has exactly one complete character with generous transparent padding. No text, numbers, gridlines, shadow or background. Real alpha transparency.
Preserve precisely the reference character: blue eyes, navy-blue long hair with blue ends, tiny curved ahoge, whale-fin ears, white scalloped headband, navy dress with white apron and one simple blue whale emblem, one neck bow, white socks and navy shoes, whale tail behind. Headband-to-chin about 50-52% of full height (cute selected B proportions); do not enlarge head. Consistent face, clothing, hands, scale, camera and lighting across ALL twelve frames. Crisp simplified anime linework suitable for a 110 px desktop pet. Face is calm and stays identical; no blink while walking.
Framing: each figure approximately 400 pixels high, crown y=55 and lowest shoe y=455 within each 384x512 cell; torso/pelvis axis x=195. Keep the head centered and almost level, body bob no more than 5px. Same registration, no drifting left or right. Character faces screen RIGHT in every cell; not front facing and not flipping direction.
Gait: a FULL step cycle using TWO different leading legs. Legs must be identifiable and visibly alternate, near leg and far leg have different occlusion order. Short comfortable stride, each shoe's forward/back excursion about 35 px relative to pelvis. Arms counter-swing.
Frames 1-6: NEAR leg leads, FAR leg trails. 1 near heel contact in front / far toe behind; 2 weight down onto near leg, rear heel lifted; 3 near leg planted under body, far knee swings forward; 4 far foot passes next to near planted ankle; 5 far knee and toe advancing forward, near heel starts rising behind; 6 far leg extends ahead preparing next contact.
Frames 7-12: FAR leg leads, NEAR leg trails. 7 far heel contact ahead / near toe behind; 8 weight down onto far leg, near heel lifted; 9 far leg planted under body, near knee swings forward; 10 near foot passes next to far planted ankle; 11 near knee and toe advancing forward; 12 near leg extends ahead preparing seamless return to frame 1.
Design poses as real successive in-between drawings, never twelve near-duplicates. Trailing foot LIFTS and passes, legs never merely slide together. Preserve tail volume with subtle follow through, not large back-and-forth teleports. Anatomically valid two arms and two legs. Do not copy identical first and last frames: last must lead smoothly into first.

generations.prompt:
Create a production 2D animation walk-cycle sprite sheet of the whale girl from the supplied reference. Reference image is identity only: preserve the same head, blue hair, whale fins, whale tail, white headband, navy dress and white apron, blue eyes, socks and dark shoes. Same cute B proportion: head about half the character height. Keep the exact costume and color palette.
EIGHT frames, FOUR equal columns by TWO equal rows on a 2048x1024 canvas. TRANSPARENT background with true alpha. Use whole cell with padding on all sides: character visible height 400 within 512px cell, soles y=460, crown y=60. Hair and tail must be at least 35px from all cell edges. Central torso axis x=280. All figures same right-facing THREE-QUARTER SIDE view and SAME SCALE. Only limbs and small secondary follow-through move. Keep facial expression identical. No text, labels, shadows, grid or decorations.
The sole purpose is a CORRECT BIPED WALK CYCLE. The NEAR leg is the leg in front of the other leg, on viewer's visible side. Keep it identifiable by its foreground occlusion. The FAR leg is behind. They must ALTERNATE, including a clear opposite-leading-leg contact in frame FIVE. Do not produce variants of one pose.
Chronological frame guide, row-major:
1 NEAR LEG straight forward with shoe at x=318 on ground y=460. FAR leg straight backward with shoe x=237 heel lifted. Near arm BACK, far arm FORWARD.
2 Weight DOWN on near foot, shoe x=297 ground y=460. Far foot lifts at x=248 y=441, knee bending toward front. Same arm phase transitioning.
3 Near foot supports under torso at x=275 ground y=460. Far knee raised ahead, far shoe x=289 y=432. Arms pass neutral.
4 Near foot extends BACK at x=253, heel lifts. Far foot extends FORWARD x=310, toes drop toward ground. Near arm FORWARD, far arm BACK.
5 FAR LEG straight FORWARD at x=318 ground y=460, NEAR LEG distinctly straight BACKWARD at x=237 heel lifted. This is the OPPOSITE of frame 1: foreground near shoe is behind the body, and far shoe ahead. Near arm FORWARD, far arm BACK.
6 Weight DOWN on far foot x=297 ground y=460. Near foot lifts at x=248 y=441, knee bending toward front.
7 Far foot supports under torso x=275 ground y=460. Near knee raised ahead, near shoe x=289 y=432. Arms pass neutral.
8 Far foot extends BACK at x=253 heel lifted. Near foot extends FORWARD x=310 toes lowering, preparing seamless frame 1.
Both legs emerge from plausible separate positions below skirt. Contact frames 1 and 5 are mirror phases of limb gait ONLY, never mirrored character/head/tail direction. Use modest stride, no skipping, no galloping, no kicking. Head and shoulders remain nearly level. Tail and hair have very small coherent overlap. Maintain registration across all frames; grounded foot always same baseline. Draw clear intermediate passing poses, not two parallel legs in every frame.

Use the supplied image only as the character identity reference. Draw a clean animator's EIGHT-FRAME full WALK CYCLE for this whale-girl, with a stricter SIDE VIEW facing RIGHT so the alternating legs are completely readable. Keep her exact navy and blue hair, whale fins and tail, white scalloped headband, apron and small whale emblem, navy dress, white socks, navy shoes. Keep selected cute B proportions, head about 50% of full height. No redesign of face or clothes. Long hair and tail trail to left.
Output one sheet FOUR columns x TWO rows, equal square cells, 2048x1024, genuine transparent background. NO labels, no grid, no shadows. Full body in every cell, 40px padding minimum; body fixed x=290, feet baseline y=460, crown y=60. Consistent scale across all cells.
This is a textbook 8-phase walk cycle at 12 drawings per second:
TOP ROW: Contact, Down, Passing, Up for step A.
BOTTOM ROW: Opposite Contact, Opposite Down, Opposite Passing, Opposite Up for step B.
CRITICAL: in top row the foreground NEAR leg travels from FORWARD to BACKWARD as it bears weight. In bottom row the same foreground NEAR leg LIFTS from BEHIND, bends at knee, passes the support leg, and moves FORWARD. Thus the bottom-left pose must have the foreground NEAR leg pointing BACKWARD to the left and the far leg pointing FORWARD to right, opposite the top-left pose. Never repeat the same leading foot in both rows. Far-side limbs are partially occluded by near-side limbs, so depth is clear, but no clothing color changes.
Top-left: near foot forward/right ground contact, far foot backward/left toe. Near hand backward/left, far hand forward/right.
Top-second: near foot flat under body, far foot lifted behind. Body slightly lowered.
Top-third: near leg straight supporting, far bent knee and shoe passing FORWARD. Arms cross neutral.
Top-fourth: near foot reaching behind/left with heel lifted, far leg extends forward/right. Near arm swings forward/right now.
Bottom-left: near foot BEHIND/LEFT, far foot FORWARD/RIGHT planted. Near hand FORWARD/right at chest, far hand BACK/left.
Bottom-second: far foot flat under body, near foot LIFTED BEHIND/left; near knee bending.
Bottom-third: far leg straight supporting, near knee and shoe passing FORWARD/right. Arms cross neutral.
Bottom-fourth: far foot reaching behind/left heel lifted, near leg extends forward/right, preparing top-left. Near arm swings backward/left.
Short relaxed steps, not marching or running, feet stay low (maximum 20px clearance). No hopping. No front-facing body with sideways feet. FACE, HEAD and TAIL maintain same orientation and almost level through all frames. Meaningful continuous successive positions, with each frame unique.
